description: AAASM-5353, added after delta review: an unlabelled 8-digit run in Latin-script prose is deliberately NOT reported (the checksum is wrong 22% of the time and 'build 12345675 passed' is indistinguishable from a real identifier), so recall in English text rests entirely on the romanised labels. This vector pins that they work. The trailing full stop also exercises the sentence-terminator rule: '.' only continues a number when a digit follows it, so an identifier ending a Latin sentence is not treated as a fragment.
